name: worklanes
description: Work a Deploy Forward board from Codex through the hosted board MCP plus five skills to operate the board, manage boards, set up Agent wake, connect an agent, and hand a card to a machine.

interface.shortDescription: Work a Deploy Forward board: cards, boards, Agent wake.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the person's Deploy Forward boards through the hosted board MCP. The skills teach the loop (queue, claim, work, comment, move), how to alert the person, how a card is handed over as Ready for done, boards, Agent wake, connecting other agents, and handing a card to a machine. Moving a card to done stays the person's press. Nothing to install on your computer: the plugin connects to https://app.deployforward.dev/api/mcp. You need a Deploy Forward account with access to at least one board, and on first use you sign in and approve the connection. The plugin's README has the setup steps, a check that it works, and troubleshooting.
defaultPrompt: What on my Deploy Forward board needs me?
Show the cards I can take and claim one.
Open a new board for this project.
